ruleDefinitions.name: File Encryption/Decryption Via Gpg4win From Suspicious Locations
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of Gpg4win to encrypt/decrypt files located in potentially suspicious locations.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\gpg\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\gpg2\\\.exe$")) OR process_product = "GNU\ Privacy\ Guard\ \(GnuPG\)" OR process_description = "GnuPG’s\ OpenPGP\ tool") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-passphrase.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\PerfLogs\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\.*")))
